Measured on develop d032c7368 (probe t1.diff, scratch t93_20/e2/): distiller 12.278G -> 12.095G (-1.49%, n=3 interleaved, fz-engine's own A/B), output byte-identical, wakes 24 -> 24, no pin moved in fz-engine / fz2_cli drain-arbiter / distill_telemetry tests.

Red first: a fz-engine test where one publisher publishes many cone facts and is checked once, observed through a walk count added to the drain's quiesced telemetry. Docs: fact-engine.md drain section. Bar: byte-identical output, no pin rises without approval.
